violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. Wiping cloth bucket at U-Cook too weak and needs changing.

Preventing contamination by consumers. — --Food on display for self service was not properly protected by food guards, display cases, or similarly effective means. Multiple sneeze guards at customer self service areas not provided with adequate sneeze protection. Guards lifted on many units. Bread stations (bagged breads) at multiple kiosks not provided with proper utensils for customers to collect product.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Grease pooling under flat grills at Sizzle. Lower shelving collecting grease spills near BOH kitchen char grill area. Hot hold unit in Sizzle has food debris build up. Main dish machine has build up on top of machine. Detail cleaning needed.

Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder or bar soap. Hand wash station at U-Cook and Salad Bar area not provided with soap in dispenser.--Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of individual disposable towels, continuous towel supply system, or heated air-drying device. Towel dispenser at U-Cook and Salad Bar area not stocked. Towel dispenser at hand sink near Savory not working properly at time of inspection.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Floor is sticky at Simple Zone. Floor is greasy at fryer area at Sizzle kiosk. Spill under char grill in BOH prep kitchen. Areas above need cleaning.
